reasoning.primary_signal: Strong TDE indicators: Nuclear position, IR-bluish WISE color, TDE-zone optical colors, and characteristic rise/decline morphology.

indicators.name: WISE W1-W2
indicators.note: IR-bluish color (< 0.5) strongly favors TDE over AGN, ruling out dust torus emission.

indicators.name: Gaia Separation
indicators.note: Source is coincident with the galaxy nucleus, consistent with TDE physics.

indicators.name: Optical Color (g-r)
indicators.note: Colors remain within the TDE zone (-0.6 to +0.1) throughout the light curve. No significant blue-to-red evolution.

indicators.name: Rise Morphology
indicators.note: Light curve shows a decelerating rise (concave shape) typical of fallback accretion, rather than the accelerating rise of shock-cooling SNe.

indicators.name: Rise Duration
indicators.note: Rise time is consistent with typical TDE fallback timescales (10-60 days).

indicators.name: Decline Shape
indicators.note: Steady decline without a plateau, consistent with t^(-5/3) decay.
